approach: Reuse shared GTK3 UI and Rust engine. Add Win32 integration, target x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm with LLVM-MinGW UCRT and MSYS2 UCRT64 GTK3 runtime. Deliver portable ZIP when validated.
